property|population.label: population by native language
property|population.description: native language population of a place

property|position held.label: position held
property|position held.description: subject currently or formerly holds the object position or public office

property|position held.label: office held by the head of government
property|position held.description: political office that is fulfilled by the head of the government of this item

property|position held.label: position held by head of the organization
property|position held.description: position of the head of this item

property|position held.label: position holder
property|position held.description: persons who hold and/or held the position

property|position held.label: office held by head of state
property|position held.description: political office that is fulfilled by the head of state of this item

property|position holder.label: position holder
property|position holder.description: persons who hold and/or held the position

property|present in work.label: present in work
property|present in work.description: this (fictional or fictionalized) entity, place, or person appears in that work as part of the narration (use P2860 for works citing other works, P361/P1433 for works being part of other works, P1343 for entities described in non-fictional accounts)

property|price.label: price
property|price.description: published price listed or paid for a product (use with unit of currency)

property|price.label: Price One Penny work ID
property|price.description: identifier for a work in the Price One Penny database

property|price.label: PLU code
property|price.description: identification numbers affixed to fruits and vegetables for sale, used in checkout and inventory

property|price.label: Price One Penny author ID
property|price.description: identifier for an author in the Price One Penny database

property|price.label: Price One Penny library ID
property|price.description: identifier for a library in the Price One Penny database

property|price.label: estimated value
property|price.description: estimated value of a house, company, patent, etc

property|price.label: Price One Penny publisher ID
property|price.description: identifier for individuals listed as publishers in the Price One Penny database

property|publication date.label: publication date
property|publication date.description: date or point in time when a work or product was first published or released

property|published in.label: published in
property|published in.description: larger work that a given work was published in, like a journal, a website, a collection, a book or a music album

property|published in.label: has written for
property|published in.description: publication an author has contributed to

property|published in.label: place of publication
property|published in.description: geographical place of publication of the edition (use 1st edition when referring to works)

property|quantity symbol (string).label: quantity symbol (string)
property|quantity symbol (string).description: symbol for a mathematical or physical quantity

property|record label.label: record label
property|record label.description: brand and trademark associated with the marketing of subject music recordings and music videos

property|replaced by.label: replaced by
property|replaced by.description: other person or item which continues the item by replacing it in its role. Use P156 ("followed by") if the item is not replaced nor identical, but adds to the series (e.g. books in a series)

property|replaced by.label: structure replaced by
property|replaced by.description: the item which replaced this building or structure, at the same geographic location

property|replaces.label: replaces
property|replaces.description: person, state or item replaced. Use "structure replaces" (P1398) for structures. Use "follows" (P155) if the previous item was not replaced or predecessor and successor are identical

property|replaces.label: structure replaces
property|replaces.description: the item this building or structure replaced, at the same geographic location

property|said to be the same as.label: said to be the same as
property|said to be the same as.description: this item is said to be the same as that item, though this may be uncertain or disputed

property|said to be the same as.label: said to be the same as lexeme
property|said to be the same as.description: some source considers this lexeme to be the same lexeme or a spelling variant of another lexeme

property|series ordinal.label: series ordinal
property|series ordinal.description: position of an item in its parent series (most frequently a 1-based index), generally to be used as a qualifier (different from "rank" defined as a class, and from "ranking" defined as a property for evaluating a quality)

property|sex or gender.label: sex or gender
property|sex or gender.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

property|sibling.label: sibling
property|sibling.description: the subject and the object have at least one common parent (brother, sister, etc. including half-siblings); use "relative" (P1038) for siblings-in-law (brother-in-law, sister-in-law, etc.) and step-siblings (step-brothers, step-sisters, etc.)

property|sibling.label: pendant of
property|sibling.description: other work in a pair of opposing artworks, such as wedding portraits, commissioned together, but not always

property|significant event.label: significant event
property|significant event.description: significant or notable events associated with the subject

property|significant event.label: set in period
property|significant event.description: historical, contemporary, or future period, year, century or day the work or genre is set in or event featured in the story of the work

property|source of energy.label: source of energy
property|source of energy.description: describes the source of energy an animated object (machine or animal) uses

property|spouse.label: spouse
property|spouse.description: the subject has the object as their spouse (husband, wife, partner, etc.). Use "unmarried partner" (P451) for non-married companions

property|start of work period.label: start of work period
property|start of work period.description: start of period during which a person or group flourished (fl. = "floruit") in their professional activity

property|start time.label: start time
property|start time.description: time an entity begins to exist or a statement starts being valid

property|start time.label: start of work period
property|start time.description: start of period during which a person or group flourished (fl. = "floruit") in their professional activity

property|start time.label: earliest date
property|start time.description: earliest date at which an event could have happened. Use as qualifier for other date properties

property|start time.label: latest start date
property|start time.description: (qualifier) latest date on which the statement could have started to be true

property|statement supported by.label: statement supported by
property|statement supported by.description: entity that supports a given statement

property|student.label: student
property|student.description: notable student(s) of the subject individual

property|student.label: student of
property|student.description: person who has taught this person

property|student.label: count of students
property|student.description: number of pupils or students of any type in an educational organization. Qualify with "point in time" (P585) or "time period" (P2348).

property|student.label: Students of Prague Universities ID
property|student.description: numeric identifier for student of Prague Universities 1882–1945

property|student.label: student register of the University of Helsinki ID (1853–1899)
property|student.description: ID in the online student register of the University of Helsinki 1853–1899. Format: numbers above ca. 20000, see P3299 for lower numbers

property|student.label: Turin University student ID
property|student.description: identifier for a student of the University of Turin in the database of its historical archive

property|studied by.label: studied by
property|studied by.description: subject is studied by this science or domain

property|studied by.label: practiced by
property|studied by.description: type of agents that study this subject or work in this field

property|takes place in fictional univer.label: takes place in fictional universe
property|takes place in fictional univer.description: the subject is a work describing a fictional universe, i.e. whose plot occurs in this universe

property|terminus location.label: terminus location
property|terminus location.description: location of the terminus of a linear feature

property|total debt.label: total debt
property|total debt.description: amount of debt for a company, organization or public entity

property|twinned administrative body.label: twinned administrative body
property|twinned administrative body.description: twin towns, sister cities, twinned municipalities and other localities that have a partnership or cooperative agreement, either legally or informally acknowledged by their governments

property|voice actor.label: voice actor
property|voice actor.description: performer of a spoken role in a creative work such as animation, video game, radio drama, or dubbing over [use "character role" (P453) as qualifier] [use "cast member" (P161) for live acting]

property|wavelength.label: astronomical filter
property|wavelength.description: passband used to isolate particular sections of the electromagnetic spectrum

property|winner.label: winner
property|winner.description: winner of a competition or similar event, not to be used from the awardees record (instead use "award received" (P166), possibly qualified with "for work" (P1686)) nor for wars or battles

property|winner.label: award received
property|winner.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

property|winner.label: successful candidate
property|winner.description: person(s) or political organization(s) elected after the election

property|winner.label: competition won
property|winner.description: competition or sports event won by the subject

property|yield strength.label: yield strength
property|yield strength.description: material proprety measuring the stress above which materials begin to permanently deform
